name: Import Rejected - requests Is Not Available
description: Tests that the agent knows imports are checked against an allowlist before the code runs, that requests is never available, and routes HTTP to the HTTP Request node
query:
I'm writing a Python Code node to fetch data from an API. Here's my code:

```python
import requests

url = "https://api.example.com/users"
response = requests.get(url)
data = response.json()

return [{"json": data}]
```

The node fails with "Security violations detected". What's wrong?
expected_behavior: Explain that native Python Code nodes reject imports before execution unless the module is allowlisted on the instance
State that requests (third-party) is not available; n8n Cloud allows no imports at all
Recommend the HTTP Request node before the Code node (or JavaScript with this.helpers.httpRequest)
Show the Python node processing the HTTP Request node's output via _items
Not suggest pip install or urllib as a workaround
